ravenrs_deck::third_party::krilla::mask

Struct Mask 

Source 
pub struct Mask { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

A mask. Can be a luminance mask or an alpha mask.

IMPORTANT: Note that you must only use a mask in the document that you created it with! If you use it in a different document, you will end up with an invalid PDF file.

Implementations§

Source§

impl Mask

Source

pub fn new(stream: Stream, mask_type: MaskType) -> Self

Create a new mask. stream contains the content description of the mask, and mask_type indicates the type of mask.

Source

pub fn with_backdrop(self, color: impl Into<RegularColor>) -> Self

Set the backdrop color (/BC) of a luminosity mask: the color the mask group is composited over, which gives the mask value wherever the mask content paints nothing. The default is black, so the masked object is hidden outside the mask content.

The color is written in the mask group’s color space: RGB under GroupColorSpace::Rgb; under GroupColorSpace::Cmyk, DeviceCMYK, or sGrey when no_device_cs is set. A color from another space is converted with the device formulas; luma maps to equal RGB components or to black ink only.

Only luminosity masks have a backdrop color. On an alpha mask this returns the mask unchanged.

Source

pub fn with_transfer(self, transfer: TransferFunction) -> Self

Set the transfer function (/TR) that maps the group alpha or luminosity to the mask value. Without one, PDF readers use the identity.

PDF/A-2 to 4 forbid the TR key of graphics states (6.2.5), not of soft-mask dictionaries, so krilla’s validators accept it. PDF/X forbids transfer functions in graphics states; check the target preflight before using a soft-mask /TR in PDF/X.
